content.text: {"answer":2,"reduction":2,"lower_bound":0,"upper_bound":2,"lower_bound_mechanism":"false finite-transversal lemma","upper_bound_mechanism":"periodic residue enumeration","wrong_answer_stated":true,"notes":"The central lemma is false. For F_n={x_1,...,x_n,y_n}, the family is pairwise intersecting, but it has infinitely many minimal finite transversals {y_1,...,y_{k-1},x_k}. Thus finiteness (F) is unproved. The characterization (C) and periodicity assembly (P), conditional on finiteness, are complete."}
